semantic_policy.hard_activation: Only narrow exact event phrases, a profile-local contextual exact match, or a direct requester definition create hard visual duties. Limit, threshold, extreme, peak, breakthrough, awakening, release, overload, phase transition, point of no return, transcendence, ascension, singularity, absolute, infinity, and evolution remain candidate-only when their event mechanism is unspecified.
semantic_policy.visual_actuation: Selected concepts are expressed as one before-state system or subject, a concrete constraint or threshold, a visible trigger or accumulation path, a localized crossing or failure mechanism, and a same-frame consequence. Glow, costume, gauge, rubble, color grading, pose, or an aftermath alone is not a substitute.
semantic_policy.state_boundary: Critical approach remains intact before transition; breakthrough creates a new aperture through a resisting barrier; limiter release disengages a functional restraint; overload exceeds a rated system and propagates failure; phase transition preserves one specimen across coexisting phases; irreversible crossing visibly removes the return path.
semantic_policy.reference_boundary: A supplied portrait may guide only observable adult appearance, hair, face proportions, wardrobe, and framing. It never supplies identity, protected traits, health, personality, occupation, transcendence, awakening, power level, or narrative status.
semantic_policy.judgment_boundary: Sublime, ultimate, absolute, infinite, enlightened, and self-transcendent remain interpretation or user-judgment claims unless a requester defines a separate observable event contract.

review_scope: Former prose-only policy and representation declarations preserved without granting runtime authority.
